title: Final Free Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the free energy F must be correctly derived and include the dependence on volume V1.

title: Total Entropy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The total entropy S must be correctly expressed in terms of P1, P2, T, and N.

title: Entropy Change Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The change in entropy ΔS must be explicitly calculated after mixing and should reflect the correct physical principles.

title: Special Case Check
description: Optional Criteria: The response should include a check for the special case where V1 equals V2, confirming that ΔS equals zero.

title: Correct Units
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all terms in the final expressions have consistent units; any unit mistakes will result in a deduction.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common sign errors in the derivation of ΔS; incorrect signs will lead to a deduction.
